name: Name
groupHint: A folder to show this host under, like PT or Staging. Pick an existing one or type a new name; leave blank for none.

secretPlaceholder.clone: Leave blank to reuse the original's

enableSocksHint: Only for pointing an app straight at this tunnel. The Router doesn't need it.
rangeNameHint: Put {ip} in the name to place the address yourself.
rangeOrder: The range ends before it starts.
rangeNoPorts: Not enough free local ports from this SOCKS port up.

hostKey.label: Trusted host key
hostKey.forgetHint: The next connection will ask you to confirm the server's key again.
hostKey.forgotten: Forgotten — the next connection asks you to confirm the server's key.

runningNotice: This tunnel is running. Saving a change to its host, login, jump or SOCKS port reconnects it right away: terminals on it close (press Enter in one to reopen it), tunnels jumping through it reconnect. Renaming doesn't reconnect.
